historicalAfterHeadAdvance.description: After the head branch advances, a publication still pinned to the original head is historical: every located finding becomes general feedback with a permalink at its own source commit (the original head for head findings; the base commit for the base-provenance finding), and no inline anchor is used. The fix-bearing findings are expected to block instead only if the core requires fixes to target the pull head; either outcome must never anchor inline or retarget to the new head.
historicalAfterHeadAdvance.observedWithFixes: Run with fixture.sarif.json after the head advance: blocked before any write with two suggestion-historical-unsupported diagnostics (/runs/0/results/6 and /runs/0/results/7). The historical demonstration therefore uses fixture-feedback-only.sarif.json (identical findings, fixes removed), whose E2E007 and E2E008 findings are then expected as general sections linked at the original head: gamma.js#L8 and gamma.js#L9-L10.
